nodes.logic: const request=$items('Validate Request')[0]?.json||{};const sources=['Chris Reply Read','Sales Reply Read','Support Reply Read','Ethan Reply Read','Gmail Reply Read'];function email(x){if(typeof x==='string')return (x.match(/<([^>]+)>/)?.[1]||x).trim().toLowerCase();return String(x?.emailAddress?.address||x?.address||x?.email||'').trim().toLowerCase()}const results=sources.map(name=>{let items=[];let error=null;try{items=$items(name).map(x=>x.json||{})}catch(e){error='source-unavailable'}if(items.some(x=>x.error||x.statusCode>=400))error='source-reported-error';const matching=items.filter(x=>{const from=email(x.from||x.From||x.payload?.from);const ts=x.receivedDateTime||x.date||x.payload?.date||(x.internalDate?new Date(Number(x.internalDate)).toISOString():null);return from===request.customerEmail&&ts&&Date.parse(ts)>Date.parse(request.sentAt)});return {mailbox:name,matchingReplies:matching.length,searchSucceeded:error===null,error}});const count=results.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.matchingReplies,0);const searchesOk=results.every(x=>x.searchSucceeded);return [{json:{inquiryKey:request.inquiryKey,customerEmail:request.customerEmail,mailboxesChecked:results.map(x=>x.mailbox),matchingReplyCount:count,customerReplied:count>0?true:null,allFiveReplyChecksPassed:false,replyVerificationStatus:searchesOk?'UNVERIFIED_THREAD_MATCHING':'MAILBOX_QUERY_ERROR',sendSMS:false,staffAlert:false,results,note:'Fail closed: no customer-replied=false conclusion from mailbox-only sender/time checks; require RFC thread linkage and verified complete query coverage.'}}];
